dedupe_keys.name: tnext transit network explorer tool oregon dot

description: The Transit Network Explorer Tool (TNExT) is web-based software for the visualisation, analysis and reporting of regional and statewide transit networks in Oregon, developed with open-source tools. The repository provides Docker containers to compile and run TNExT with a PostGIS database, and instructions to restore a database snapshot (the example is May 2018) and configure census and GTFS mapping sources. Coverage: Oregon transit networks, or any network loaded into the database. Format and access: source code and Docker set-up in a public repository. Licence and cost: free to obtain; no licence file was found at the repository root. Caveats: the example snapshot dates from 2018, suggesting limited recent activity, and snapshots are not bundled. It supports network flow and capacity planning reviews of statewide transit coverage. It relates to the GTFS-ride standard from the same Oregon section and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
